parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is the handle portion, typically made of steel with a rubber coating for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and allows the user to apply force to the jaws of the pliers. The rubber coating improves grip and reduces hand fatigue.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint when the pliers are opened or closed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers includes the jaws and pivot mechanism, made of hardened steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main working part of the pliers, gripping, cutting, or bending materials depending on the plier type.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary except for the jaw tips, which move relative to each other around the pivot point.
